--background.Name: --background
--background.description: Opens Xcode without activating it; the process that invoked xed remains in front

--create.Name: --create
--create.description: Creates any non-existent files in the file list. If used without --launch, standard input will be read and piped to the last file created

--launch.Name: --launch
--launch.description: Launches Xcode, opening a new empty unsaved file

--line.Name: --line
--line.description: Selects the given line in the last file opened

--version.Name: --version
--version.description: Prints the version number of xed

--wait.Name: --wait
--wait.description: Wait for the files to be closed before exiting. xed will idle and will only terminate when all files are closed
